lead.headline: Wilson ruled out; Knight's ruling makes Allgeier the FLEX
lead.deck: Wilson OUT Friday; Bam Knight OUT lifts Allgeier to 13.3 — the lineup as set is now the projection lineup.
lead.body: The bad news first. Garrett Wilson was ruled out for Kansas City on Friday afternoon, the concussion that kept him out of practice all week. The rest of the day broke AVIATO's way: Arizona ruled out Bam Knight, also a concussion, leaving Tyler Allgeier the only established back with Jeremiyah Love on injured reserve, and ESPN moved him from 9.3 to 13.3. That reverses this morning's advice — Allgeier, already in the FLEX, now projects 2.0 above Alvin Kamara, so leave it. Philadelphia confirmed Joe Milton III for his first start and ruled out DeVonta Smith, which is the Giants D/ST's week. Kamara drew no game designation. AVIATO lead 8.9 to 5.58 and ESPN calls it 49-51; there is nothing left to set.

doFirst.headline: Nothing to set
doFirst.deck: The lineup as set is the projection lineup; no starter carries a designation.
doFirst.note: This morning's Kamara swap is withdrawn — Knight's ruling moved Allgeier above him. Nothing on the wire beats a starter.
doFirst.empty: Nothing to decide before Sunday: Wilson's ruling settled the bench, and Knight's put the right back in the FLEX.

roster.deck: Gap zero: the FLEX the owner set on Thursday night became the projection's pick when Arizona ruled out Knight.
